messages:
mike: Heads-up: canary-meter is tripping rate-limit alarms for credflow v2.0.1 at 5% in us-west-2. Seeing 429s and p99 tail increase. Recommend pausing regional bump and deciding soft-rollback vs full rollback.

deploy-bot: deploybot: Canary rollout started: credflow v2.0.1 -> 5% us-west-2 at 2812345665. Health: degraded, errors: 0.7% (baseline 0.03%), 429 spikes on ratelimit-proxy, p99 +160ms.

ops-anya: Link to dashboard pls so we can see whether it's proxy or upstream saturation.
mike: https://monitoring.redwood/internal/d/credflow-canary  p95 190ms, p99 580ms, 429s concentrated at proxy tier in us-west-2.

ke: If proxy is hitting token bucket limits only in us-west-2, we can soft-rollback (drain region) and leave other regions alone. That avoids touching the global change window. +1 to hold.
sara: Agreed. Also propose we temporarily increase proxy rate-limit in us-west-2 for the canary slice only, while we drain the canary, to see if it's misconfiguration vs real load.

ops-anya: Command to run for pin/drain: ```sh
redwood routing override --svc credflow --region us-west-2 --target v1.9.8 --drain-canary --reason "soft-rollback: 429 spikes in proxy"
```

pm-oliver: Quick question: we already published release notes for v2.0.1. Do we need to retract or amend?
mike: No retraction. We'll append: "Partial rollout in us-west-2 paused due to rate-limit regression; investigating. No global rollback at this time." PMs will push the note.

ke: Rollback/runbook thresholds for this thread: sustained 429s > 0.8% for 5m OR p99 > 800ms for 10m -> escalate to full rollback (set global stable to v1.9.8 and cancel other canaries). If proxy config tweak (rate-limit exception) fixes it, then resume after 30m of stable telemetry.

deploy-bot: deploybot: Routing override ticket #ROUTE-72019 created by ops-anya. Pending execution.

ops-anya: Executing routing override now and applying temporary proxy exception to the canary slice. Will post back.

(22s)

ops-anya: Done. us-west-2 pinned to v1.9.8 with canary drained; temporary canary-only proxy limit increased by +25%. Verified traffic shift to stable nodes; 429s dropped quickly and p99 trended down within ~50s. :white_check_mark:

mike: Good mitigation. For now leave logical canary at 5% config but drained in us-west-2. HOLD on percent bumps or cross-region promotions until infra verifies proxy config and we run a 30m observation window.

pm-oliver: I'll add the release-note addendum and notify CS with the one-liner. Also flag customers who had pre-release access.

ke: Assigning to infra/proxy and infra/serving for deep-dive. Please check token-bucket config, sidecar versions, and any rate-limit rollout changes in the last 48h.

deploy-bot: deploybot: Canary status changed -> HOLD (5%, drained in us-west-2) by ops-anya at 2812345798.

sara: ack. Reopen thread if metrics deteriorate or we decide on full rollback.
